images.description: Up to two images: the main one and a second (hover) image.

price_varies.description: Variants differ in price: show the price as "from".

stock.description: The best state over the product's variants.

description_html.description: Sanitized server-side; the only HTML a theme may render unescaped.

variants.description: Variants sold in this market, in the merchant's order.

ProductInput.description: A product document, as written by `POST /products` and `PUT /products/{id}`.

tax_categories.description: Country -> tax category code (`reduced`, ...); countries not listed use `standard` (A3).

unit_quantity.description: Content in `unit_measure` units (0.75 for 750 ml with `l`); set together with it.

variant_sku.description: Shows the image for one variant only (by SKU).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page.

ProductSummary.description: A row of the product list.

description_html.description: Sanitized on write: unsafe markup is removed.

model.description: The model that wrote it (`fake` for the demo provider).

warnings.description: Things to check before accepting (e.g. a glossary term not kept).

Purposes.description: Per-purpose choices: `None` = not asked (or not part of this choice).

status.description:
`ok` when every dependency is `ok`; `degraded` when only Meilisearch fails (search
answers 503, the shop keeps working, spec A27/A30); `fail` when a core dependency
(database, storage) fails.

new.description: `false` for a redelivery of an event already stored (a no-op).

oneOf.description: The customer's interests, when personalization is allowed.

names.description: Names of the skipped products (recommended ones carry theirs in the card).

personalization.description: The customer's `personalization` consent is granted (always false without one).

excluded_product_ids.description: Never recommended (gift cards, samples, ...). At most 500.

cache.description:
Public for the anonymous variant; private (and `Cache-Control: private, no-store`)
when the request carried a cart or a consent subject (A2).

oneOf.description:
The strategy of the first product, so a theme can title the slot ("Frequently bought
together", "For you", ...); absent when there are no products.

title.description: A merchant collection's heading when the products come from one.

from_path.description: Path on the shop, without query string: `/stara-kategorie`.

to_path.description: Path on the same shop, may carry a query string: `/p/novy-produkt`.

iban.description: Where a bank refund goes (bank transfer, cash on delivery), shown to the person paying it.

lines.description: Goods to refund: more units of order lines.

RefundLine.description: A goods line to refund: `quantity` more units of an order line.

RefundPlan.description: What a refund would return (also the admin preview).

full.description: Everything the customer paid is refunded after this.

iban.description: Bank refunds: the account to pay.

note.description: E.g. the carrier's payout reference, at most 500 characters.

html.description: Full HTML document (show it in a sandboxed iframe).

Resolved.description: What the edge needs to serve a hostname (spec §5.1, `GET /internal/v1/resolve`).

checkout_artifact.description: The platform checkout artifact (same for every tenant, §9.4).

retained_artifacts.description: Earlier artifacts whose `/_astro/*` assets stay served (A22).

storefront_token.description: The tenant's public storefront token (§5.5); the edge injects it, never the browser.

theme_artifact.description: Active theme artifact; `None` until a theme is published for the tenant.

ResolvedRedirect.description: What the edge needs to answer a redirect.

tokens.description: Design tokens of the built artifact (`colors`, `fonts`, `radius`), if built.

active.description: The revision the shop currently serves.

failures.description: Why the gates failed (from the check report), empty otherwise.

origin.description: `default` (follows the shared default theme) or `custom` (tenant-owned source).

Role.description:
Staff roles, weakest first (spec §5.3). `staff` has no settings, payment config, staff
management or exports.

line.description: Line in the file (the header is line 1).

oneOf.description: Percent off in basis points (1500 = 15 %), rounded half up to the minor unit.
A fixed amount off each unit; applies only to price lists in `currency`.

starts_at.description: Default: now. A start in the past means now; a started sale keeps its start.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next (older) page; absent on the last page.

category_ids.description: Products in these categories or any of their subcategories.

aov_minor.description: Average order value, minor units (0 without orders).

revenue_minor.description:
Sum of order totals (placed, not cancelled) less what was refunded of them (WP12,
netted on the order's day), minor units.

at.description: When to start; `null` or the past = now.

image.description: The first product image, in the list-sized variants (up to 640 px).

in_stock.description: At least one variant can be bought now.

price.description: Current price of the matched variant in the market (gross).

variant_id.description: The variant that matched best (e.g. the red one when filtering by red).

oneOf.description: Price span of the products matching the query and category (without facet filters).

total.description: Matching products (before rehydration dropped any that just became unavailable).

indexes.description: One index per locale the tenant's markets sell in.

Selector.description: Which products change: every non-empty condition must hold.

oneOf.description: Required for pickup-point carriers: the widget's selection.

cod_fee_minor.description: Cash-on-delivery fee (gross), charged as the payment fee.

free_over_minor.description: Free when the goods after the coupon reach this amount.

price_minor.description: Flat price (gross, market currency) when there are no weight tiers.

weight_tiers.description: Ascending by weight; empty = flat price.

needs_pickup_point.description: Pickup-point carriers: the widget to choose the point with.

oneOf.description: The live rate for this cart; `null` when the cart cannot use the method (too heavy).

name.description: The method's name in the order's locale, as it was at placement.

base_path.description:
`""` in the market's default locale, else `/<locale>` (spec §9.1). Page-model hrefs
already carry it; themes prefix the links they build themselves (`/search`,
`/p/<slug>`, `/_p/public/*`).

checkout_url.description:
The checkout origin (`https://checkout.<shop host>`, A1): account, order status and the
withdrawal form (`/withdraw`, A19) live there, not on the theme's origin.

oneOf.description:
Free shipping from this order value (the lowest threshold of the market's active
shipping methods); `None` when no method has one.

legal_pages.description:
Published legal pages (terms, privacy, withdrawal, complaints, ...), except the cookies
page, which is `consent.policy_url`.

locale.description: Active locale (`cs`); also the `lang` of pages.

locales.description: Locales of this market, the default first, each with its home page URL.

markets.description: The tenant's markets (other shops of the same merchant).

messages.description: Platform UI messages in the active locale (`cart.add` -> "Přidat do košíku").

tokens.description: Design tokens of the active theme (A6).

redirect.description: Relative path on the checkout origin to continue to.

enabled.description:
`true`: onboarding completed (charges enabled, card payments active); `false`: the
card_payments capability is lost (Stripe disappears from checkout, A11).

Source.description: Where a feed comes from (also the `import_mappings.source`).

duplicates.description: Lines already imported earlier (same bank transaction id): ignored.

exceptions.description: New lines waiting in the exceptions queue.

matched.description: New lines that paid an order.

checks.description: The gate report (JSON object, at most 256 kB).

token.description:
Public storefront token of the tenant (the edge sends it; it grants only public reads
and cart operations of this tenant).

Strategy.description: Where a recommended product came from.

ready.description: Stripe is offered at checkout (charges enabled and card payments active).

oneOf.description: The shop's connected account, once onboarding started.
`null`: the platform has no Stripe configuration (Stripe cannot be offered).

customer_id.description: The customer account with the same (verified) address.

requested_at.description:
Consent evidence: when the sign-up was requested and confirmed, and the consent text
version shown (the IP hashes are stored but never shown).

secret_hint.description: The secret's last characters, to tell secrets apart.

event_types.description: Event types a subscription can ask for.

SubscriptionWithSecret.description: Returned by create and rotate only: the signing secret is never shown again.

groups.description: Each group lists 2-20 equivalent words or phrases.

rate.description: Percent as a decimal string, e.g. `"12"` or `"13.5"`.

TaxMode.description: Whether prices are entered gross (B2C, default) or net.

cash_rounding_in_vat_base.description:
Whether the cash rounding line is taxed (A16). Default false: outside the VAT base.
Confirm with an accountant before enabling.

origin_threshold_confirmed_at.description: When the merchant confirmed eligibility for the origin-country threshold regime.

confirm_origin_threshold.description:
Required (true) when switching to `origin_threshold`: the merchant confirms their EU
distance sales stay under EUR 10 000 per year. The time of confirmation is stored.

TemplateText.description: One editable template text set in one language: the platform default and the tenant's.

intro.description: The tenant's intro paragraph (`{shop}` is filled in).

subject.description: The tenant's subject (`{shop}` and, for order mail, `{number}` are filled in).

base_revision_id.description: The revision whose source is edited; default: the active revision.

tokens.description: `{colors, fonts, radius}`: allowlisted keys and values (A6).

rum_sample_rate.description: Share of consented page views that report Web Vitals (spec §9.6).

conversion_rate.description:
Consented sessions with a purchase / consented sessions (by session start day);
`None` without sessions.

funnel.description: Labelled "consented sessions" (A20): visitors without consent are not in it.

UnitMeasure.description: Basis of the unit price shown next to the price (per kg, per l, ...).

UnitPrice.description: Price per unit of measure (EU price indication directive), e.g. per 1 kg.

UploadTarget.description: Where and how to upload the file.

headers.description: Headers the upload must send exactly as given (they are part of the signature).

cost_micros.description: USD micros this month at the configured list prices.

month_start.description: Start of the metered calendar month (UTC).

tokens_quota.description: Monthly allowance: the plan default or a superadmin override.

tokens_used.description: Tokens used this month (input incl. cache reads/writes + output).

ean.description: GTIN-8/12/13/14 with a valid check digit.

id.description: Existing variant to update; omit for a new variant.

is_default.description: At most one; defaults to the first variant.

option_values.description: One value code per product option: `{"color": "red", "size": "m"}`.

amount_minor.description: Gross base price in minor units.

compare_at_minor.description: Display-only "was"/recommended price, never a reduction basis (A18).

intervals.description: The full effective-price timeline, oldest first, including scheduled future changes.

oneOf.description: The current base price entry (absent when the variant is not priced in this list).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page.

image_index.description: Index into `product.images` of this variant's first image.

up_to_g.description: Carts up to this weight (grams, inclusive) pay `price_minor`.

late.description: Declared after the 14-day period (the merchant decides).

overdue.description: The refund deadline has passed without a refund.

deadline.description: delivered + 14 days (the statutory period; later declarations are still recorded).

eligible.description: The order has left the warehouse (before that it is cancelled, not withdrawn).

needs_iban.description: Bank transfer and cash on delivery are refunded to a bank account: the form asks for it.

staff_jwt.description: EdDSA JWT from the auth service (`GET /api/auth/token`), aud=admin-api
